messages:
nora (PM): Leadership asked for a concise Private Deploy MVP for VPC/on-prem packaging by Friday. We need: concrete launch criteria, top risks, and owners. Keep replies short and concrete.

sam (eng): From eng: MVP should include - BYO-VPC peering runbook + verified CIDR examples, - offline installer bundle that respects HTTP(S)_PROXY, - pre-upgrade DB snapshot + documented rollback command. Risk: cross-cloud peering permutations (AWS Transit vs GCP VPC peering) increase test matrix.

marco (eng-lead): Add: deterministic installer hashing (signed bundles) for air-gapped installs and an install preflight that checks DNS and firewall rules. ETA for core bits if prioritized: ~3 weeks.

diane (security): Security gating items: customer-managed KMS/HSM support for secrets, cert-rotation dry-run in CI, TLS 1.3 baseline, and audit-log export to customer SIEM. Cert-rotation test is mandatory for GA.

ryan (solutions): Customers want a single-sheet network diagram + a step-by-step runbook they can hand to their netops. Also expect a rollback playbook we can demo during pilot. Acceptance criteria should be demoable.

felix (infra): For session continuity: MVP approach = short drain window + pre-upgrade snapshot; post-MVP = KV cache warm handoff. If we choose MVP approach, we'll need a CLI flag to force immediate drain. That adds ~1 week.

maria (cs): Two pilots are blocked by upgrade uncertainty. To move them we need a published runbook, an upgrade/rollback dry-run with a pilot, and a customer-facing acceptance checklist.

nora (PM): Draft MVP bucket (proposal):
  - Runbook + Terraform/CLI snippets for AWS/GCP/Azure + one-page diagram
  - Offline installer bundle + proxy support + signed artifacts
  - Pre-upgrade DB snapshot + one-command rollback + dry-run restore in sandbox
  - KMS integration + cert-rotation CI test
  - Pilot verification slot (must be scheduled before GA)
Post-GA: cross-cloud peering automation, warm-cache handoff, advanced observability toggles.

sam (eng): +1. Release gate idea: CI must run snapshot->restore dry-run successfully on a CI playground before any GA upgrade. Also add a rollback matrix mapping failure classes to actions.

marco (eng-lead): Add a labelled caveat in docs: multi-AZ clusters required for GA. Single-AZ is evaluation-only. Also require minimum instance sizing guidance in runbook.

felix (infra): Operational caveat: if customers use custom NIC drivers or SR-IOV, include a NIC appendix in runbook. Not MVP unless a pilot requests it.

ryan (solutions): Demo acceptance script we can run with pilot (timing targets):
  1) Establish peering + validate control-plane connectivity in <=60m
  2) Perform upgrade while generating steady sessioned traffic; rollback if errors >1% within 15m
  3) Rotate KMS key and verify requests succeed for 5 minutes

diane (security): Add pre-onboarding gates: verify KMS key policy & ACLs, confirm SIEM ingestion of audit logs, and run cert-rotation dry-run. These must be green before customer onboarding.

maria (cs): I'll recruit a pilot and schedule a verification window. Will ask them to have a netops engineer on the call.

nora (PM): Action items (owners + due):
  - infra (felix): documented drain-based upgrade plan + snapshot/restore script (due in 10d)
  - solutions+cs (ryan, maria): runbook + diagrams for AWS/GCP/Azure + one-page checklist (due in 6d)
  - security (diane): cert-rotation CI job + KMS ACL checklist (due in 12d)
  - eng (sam/marco): offline bundle format + signed artifacts + preflight check (due in 11d)

sam (eng): We'll add a --preflight-snapshot flag that performs snapshot + restore to temp namespace for CI/dry-runs.

marco (eng-lead): Note licensing review needed for one of the packaging components. I'll surface legal ticket today.

deploy-bot: Automated note: created task RI-953 "private-deploy-offline-bundle" assigned to sam.

nora (PM): Messaging guidance: do NOT use "zero-downtime." Prefer "graceful, non-disruptive upgrades for sessioned traffic" and enumerate caveats (short quiesce window, multi-AZ requirement). Also include fallback: automatic fallback to hosted model endpoints if local capacity is insufficient.

felix (infra): Request for runbook: include a recovery drill that restores a snapshot to a sandbox cluster so customers can validate restores without touching prod.

diane (security): Also require a checklist step: verify key rotation policies and HSM access (if used).

maria (cs): Pilot availability confirmed for next Tuesday. I'll share the invite and acceptance script.

nora (PM): I'll draft the PRD (MVP buckets + SLA proposal: target 99.5% session continuity for planned upgrades) and post to roadmap channel by Thursday COB. Flag blockers here.

sam (eng): None from eng besides the licensing review. We'll aim for the timeline.

marco (eng-lead): If infra incidents appear, I'll flag timeline slips.

nora (PM): Thanks all. Closing thread — PRD link incoming.
